resolutions.description: The release scope, rules and constraints were defined.

source.quote: The first release integrates inventory from three faculties and allows university members to request assets and reserve rooms. Members sign in using their university accounts. Faculty staff maintain assets belonging to their faculty. University staff can view all faculties. Department staff can view their department assets. Each request or room reservation is approved by the administrator of the faculty that owns the asset; approval is required before confirmation. A room cannot have overlapping confirmed reservations. Start and end times use the Europe/Kyiv time zone and the end must be later than the start. A rejected request remains visible to its requester with a rejected status. University staff resolve duplicate source records manually before import; the prototype does not automatically merge ambiguous duplicates. The goal is to provide a shared view of inventory and a clear request approval workflow. The Product Owner accepts the release after the agreed inventory and reservation scenarios pass user acceptance testing. The first release is due eight weeks after requirements approval.

resolutions.description: Accountability for project phases was assigned.

source.quote: The Product Owner is accountable for specification acceptance and user acceptance testing. The Business Analyst is responsible for preparing the specification. The Full-stack Developer is accountable for implementation and deployment. The QA Engineer is accountable for test execution. The Product Owner is accountable for the final release decision.
